list.narrative: East Asia origin (semiconductor/electronics feedstock) -> PSA Singapore -> road transfer -> Changi Airfreight Centre -> European destination
list.demonstrates: Demonstrates high-value electronics/semiconductor freight, multi-leg transshipment through PSA, and the sea-air cost/carbon trade-off for time-critical exports

list.narrative: PSA Singapore -> Tanjung Pelepas -> Laem Chabang -> Tanjung Priok (short-sea feeder network)
list.demonstrates: Demonstrates Singapore's transshipment-hub role feeding regional ASEAN ports by short-sea feeder vessel, multi-port routing, and regional warehousing

list.narrative: Container shipment through IDJKT/SGTUA flagged for berth congestion; AI recommends an alternative routing/terminal window to protect vessel turnaround time
list.demonstrates: Demonstrates port congestion detection, AI-recommended rerouting, vessel turnaround optimisation, and the carbon/cost impact of a rerouting decision
